notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
This update introduces some fixes.

[h2]Fixed issues:[/h2]

[list]
[*] German translation typos
[*] Short hair showing while helmet is on
[*] Widgets uploaded via injectors crashing
[*] Static skeletons error accumulation
[*] Dead slashies roaring
[*] Missing outro issue
[*] Light landing skip with gamepad
[*] Character suit hole
[*] PowerPipe phantom power
[*] Minor issues through the NTartha campaign (physics, navmesh, typos, climbs etc)
[/list]

[h2]Scripts changed:[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Directors/Haydee/Fall.dir
[*] Directors/Bots/BotBase.dir
[*] Directors/Recooo/PowerPipes.dir, PowerPipesAny.dir, PowerPipesSplit.dir
[/olist]

[h2]Warning:[/h2]

New power pipes scripts may conflict with existing saves (there are only two places in the campaign). In this case just switch the nearest power switch in the correct position again.
